name: Brimon
summary: 自称最速の Kaithe 乗り。「高慢」の化身
> “Name's Brimon. Fastest Kaithe rider in the Kingdom. If you think you're faster… prove it.”
> Brimon is the self-proclaimed fastest Kaithe rider in Duviri and the avatar of pride. He is in charge of overseeing the Kaithe Racing objectives, where the Drifter can choose to race against him.
sections: Brimon is a boastful individual, claiming that no one, Dax, demon, or other, can beat him in a race. He also states that Bombastine once raced against him, but ended up losing.
Despite his pride, Brimon will begrudgingly admit defeat when the Drifter wins.
